prompt: Which of the four Red-Black Tree rules is a newly-inserted red node most likely to violate?
explanation: A new node is always colored red; if its parent is also red, rule 3 (no red node has a red child) is violated and fixup is triggered.

prompt: What is the worst-case height bound of a Red-Black Tree with n nodes?
explanation: Height ≤ 2·log(n+1), which keeps search/insert/delete at Θ(log n) even in the worst case.
